cases.label: Bun
cases.description: Execute JavaScript or TypeScript code in a persistent Bun REPL. Top-level `await`, `return`, and static `import` statements are supported. Variables, imports, and loaded data persist across calls, and are revived on a best-effort basis when a session is resumed (values that cannot be serialized are dropped and reported). Run shell commands with `bash('cmd')` / `await bash('cmd')`, `sh('cmd')`, or Bun Shell `$`. Project builds, tests, scripts, CLIs, and dependency checks should run through the target project's own environment.

code.description: JavaScript or TypeScript code to execute in the persistent Bun REPL. Use the target project's own environment for project builds, tests, scripts, CLIs, and dependency checks instead of direct kernel imports.

timeout.description: Seconds before this cell is interrupted (default 60 unless the user configured otherwise, max 180).
